protocol.matched_template_selection: For each class, take the first M_c token-unique templates in frozen source order; M_c is its effective description count, at most 20.
protocol.template_pool_scope: The fixed 60-template pool; not a complete 80-template ensemble or every possible template set.

student.label: CoOp
student.meaning: Original epoch-20 CoOp student posterior; no description fusion.

matched_template_probability_fusion.label: Matched-count template fusion
matched_template_probability_fusion.meaning: 0.5 * softmax(student_logits) + 0.5 * softmax(frozen_matched_template_mean_logits); same per-class text count as the description branch.

provenance.inventory_definition: SHA-256 of ordered path/label/classname/size/mtime inventory; not an image-byte hash
provenance.identity_check: Exact receipt.identity and receipt.cache_sha256 equality across seeds within each dataset/split; recorded hashes are compared, image/cache bytes are not reread by this analyzer
provenance.identity_sha256_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(original identity, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon), ensure_ascii=False).
provenance.export_scope: Exact original summary values and branch names; redundant all-pairs paired_deltas and prediction-level cases omitted. The standard-library summarizer checks stored HMs and recomputes the requested comparisons.
